title: Sam Darnold to start for Seahawks in Week 3 after season-opening injury in stunner

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sam Darnold to start for Seahawks in Week 3 after season-opening injury in stunner
sources.description: Darnold, 29, suffered a glute and hip injury just five snaps into Seattle's season opener and was on the sideline for its 31-7 Week 2 win over the Cardinals.
